title: The chore coat
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Winter. Alone. Faster. A strip about a coat.

panels.composition: The beach, December, wind. WOOD in the chore coat, collar up. BARNABY leaning into the wind.

image.prompt: a young man in a canvas chore coat with the collar up leaning into wind on a December beach, a small dog leaning into it beside him, wind drawn as fast horizontal lines, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The coat. Frayed cuff. A button gone. Ink on the pocket.

image.prompt: close-up of a worn canvas chore coat: a frayed cuff, a missing button, an ink stain on the pocket

panels.composition: Wood, to the dog, fast — the whole strip is drawn faster.

balloons.text: Same coat as the bus stop. Same coat as the frame shop. If the coat's the same, the man's the same. That's logic.

image.prompt: a young man on a windy beach talking fast to a small dog, the linework loose and quick

panels.composition: The two of them small on the beach. The coat the only dark shape. The line so fast it's almost nothing.

image.prompt: two tiny figures on a wide windy beach, one a dark coat-shaped mark, drawn in a few fast strokes, black and white, no words
image.notes: The fastest-drawn daily so far. Let it look it.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)
